scenes.summary: Operator Bonnie reports the depot node activated safety protocols during the Landbreaker assault and requires your authorization to resume operations. She also notes the node is now ready for integration with the AIC.

lines.text: You're ... the Endministrator! Thank you for saving me. Please, just call me Bonnie.
I was evacuating when I spotted these Landbreakers attacking our Endfield Express depot node! I couldn't just stand by and let that happen!
Though I'm just a regular operator, heh. Good thing you were here!
They're supply warehouses set up by Endfield Express across various regions, serving as relay stations for the Delta Bot emergency logistics network!
But even though it wasn't damaged, the depot node activated its safety protocols and relocked itself. I don't have the authority to override the lockdown.
With your authority, you should definitely be able to reactivate it!
By the way... I've heard that according to the earlier iteration plan for the transport network, the depot node can now be integrated into the AIC.
I'll be waiting for your good news!

scenes.summary: You successfully reactivate the depot node, but Bonnie discovers that many Delta Bots have gone offline due to the Ætherside disaster and cannot be dispatched. She explains that by elevating the node's operations level, you can obtain advanced authority privileges to resume transport operations.

lines.text: You've already unlocked the depot node? As expected of the Endministrator!
The system shows this node is now fully integrated into the AIC! You must have noticed the local depot capacity has been upgraded as well!
Now we can dispatch Delta Bots to deliver emergency supplies from this node to those in need!
If I remember correctly, the command should be... Huh? Why is this happening?
Dispatch failed... It's likely because many Delta Bots have gone offline due to the Ætherside disaster...
In that case, we'll have to initiate manual transport, but...

Most emergency supply routes are highly dangerous. According to regulations, regular operators like me who haven't received specialized training from the Specialist Tech Division aren't authorized to handle deliveries...
That's right! You can definitely do it. You're the Endministrator!
Please prioritize elevating the operations level of the depot node. Doing so will grant you advanced authority for packing goods, redistribution bids, and logistics coordination.
Endfield Express — your success, we profess!

options: I can take it from here.
